data.desc: Luda Technology Group Limited is a manufacturer and trader of stainless steel and carbon steel flanges and fittings products. The Company's history began with Luda Development Limited, incorporated in Hong Kong in 2004 and principally engaged in trading steel flanges and fittings. The Company also trades steel pipes, valves, and other steel tubing products and serves customers in China and international markets. The Company is evaluating opportunities to expand into critical and advanced materials, data center and AI computing infrastructure, and related supply chain activities. It is also evaluating additional mining acquisition opportunities in Mongolia and potential arrangements to trade mineral products produced by third-party mining operations in Mongolia for sale into China. The Company has no prior operating history in mining and does not currently employ personnel with mining expertise.
